text: 11月5日至10日，第九届中国国际进口博览会在上海举行。会上，一系列重磅科技亮相。上海微电子装备集团携自主研发的新一代前道干式扫描投影光刻机SSC800、SSB800（模型）亮相中国馆，展示我国前道光刻装备自主化的阶段性成果。据悉，目前国产前道干式光刻机成像性能已与国际同类领先产品水平相当，套刻精度、生产效率紧密追赶国际标杆。（上证报）
text_en: From November 5 to 10, the 9th China International Import Expo was held in Shanghai. At the expo, a series of major technological achievements were unveiled. Shanghai Micro Electronics Equipment Group brought its self-developed new-generation front-end dry scanning projection lithography machines SSC800 and SSB800 (models) to the China Pavilion, showcasing the phased achievements of China's front-end lithography equipment localization. It is reported that the imaging performance of domestic front-end dry lithography machines is now comparable to that of leading international products of the same kind, and overlay accuracy and production efficiency are closely catching up with international benchmarks. (Shanghai Securities News)
